GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2025-03-07T20:09:24Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Suggestion - Add Support for download through HTTPS Connections
Description: Thanks again for your work!

I’d be really grateful if you could look into another issue. When accessing the LoRA loader page via an HTTP Cloudflare address (e.g., when deploying on RunPod) instead of through TCP, attempting to download a LoRA results in the following error:

Failed to construct 'WebSocket': An insecure WebSocket connection may not be initiated from a page loaded over HTTPS.

I'm not sure how easily this can be fixed, but if you have time to address it, it could significantly enhance the usability of your plugin for cloud deployments.

Thanks!

llm_response:
CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is about a WebSocket connection error when trying to download a LoRA file through HTTPS connections. The problem is clearly described as a mixed content security issue - attempting to establish an insecure WebSocket connection from a page loaded over HTTPS. This is a well-known web security constraint where browsers block insecure (HTTP) connections from secure (HTTPS) contexts. 

The solution would involve ensuring that WebSocket connections also use secure protocols (WSS instead of WS) when the page is loaded over HTTPS. This is a configuration/code change that can be verified through code analysis without needing to build the entire environment. A reviewer can check if the code properly detects the connection protocol (HTTP vs HTTPS) and uses the appropriate WebSocket protocol (WS vs WSS) accordingly.

Since this is fundamentally about proper protocol handling in web connections, an LLM or human reviewer can verify the correctness of a solution by examining the code changes without needing to build and run the application.
